# Flash Forward Foundation

> Flash Forward Foundation is a student-founded, IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) public charity developing solar-powered study lights for students living without reliable electricity.

## About Us

Flash Forward designs, builds, and distributes solar-powered study lights through volunteer-led work. The Sponsor a Light Program invites monthly sponsorship of one light and describes following it from build to placement. The current build cost is $5.17 per light; shipping and distribution are funded separately.

Dedication requests are handled first through the contact form. The team confirms availability and next steps before a dedication proceeds.
